title: Note: reading a ghost story, part 3
summary: The story reaches its tense scene, and several earlier structures turn up in real use.

blocks.text: This episode finishes the part of the ghost story begun in the last two episodes. It recaps the plot so far: a woman goes back to a friend's apartment for a forgotten phone, gets no answer at the door, finds it unlocked and walks in. Then it reads the next lines.

items: 電気がついている means the light is on; 電気をつける is to switch it on. Which verb you see tells you whether someone acted or the light simply is on.
A verb can end in a more literary shape, such as おらず in place of いなくて or いなかった. It means "not being", linking to what comes next.
Many points from earlier lessons appear together in real text, which is the best proof that the structure is useful.
When a point is unclear, look it up after you finish the passage, then read the passage again.
